summary: "Spilled Perfume" is a country song co-written and recorded by American country music artist Pam Tillis. It was released in March 1994 as the lead single from her album "Sweetheart's Dance". The note credits Tillis and Dean Dillon as its songwriters.
one_line: "Spilled Perfume" is a 1994 country single by Pam Tillis, released as the lead single from her album "Sweetheart's Dance".
key_facts: "Spilled Perfume" is a song co-written and recorded by American country music artist Pam Tillis.
"Spilled Perfume" was the lead single from the album "Sweetheart's Dance".
The song "Spilled Perfume" was written by Pam Tillis and Dean Dillon.
